resources.string: Bixby button toggles the flashlight. While audio plays, a quick press of volume up or down skips to the next or previous track; holding changes the volume. Only hardware key presses are seen; screen content is not accessible to this service. The Bixby button is detected from two system log tags.
Running in the background. Shortcuts work with the screen on or off.
Turn on SideKeys in Accessibility settings to use the shortcuts.
The flashlight shortcut reads the Bixby button from the system log. Grant access once from a computer, then turn the service off and on.
adb shell pm grant com.unl0cker.bixby android.permission.READ_LOGS
Press the Bixby button to turn the flashlight on or off.
While audio plays, a quick press of volume up or down skips to the next or previous track. Hold to change the volume.
